ModMetaData.name: RimMT
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: RimMT V0.4.19-JS1.1S4 Tail Rescue is built directly on the validated JS1.1S1 baseline for RimWorld 1.5. Normal JobPackages retain S1 behavior: ThingRequest-backed JobGiver ClosestThingReachable searches with at least 256 candidates may use the validated nearest-first path. S4 does not use S2 fanout or S3 learned admission. Instead, each TryIssueJobPackage records only a start timestamp; small and medium searches remain Vanilla until that same JobPackage has already exceeded 32ms. After the tail threshold, later ThingRequest searches with at least 16 candidates and explicit custom IEnumerable Thing sets may use the same validator-first/live-CanReach rescue path. The original WorkGiver validator and live map.reachability.CanReach remain authoritative. JR1/JR1.1 remain retired. ReachProfile retains JS1.1R rolling-fuse behavior.
